pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: Your video went blurry instead of freezing. The app chose that.
But how does it switch mid-video?
Streaming apps cut video into short chunks, each saved in several qualities.
The player picks each next chunk by how full its buffer is.
Weak signal drains the buffer, so it grabs smaller chunks.
In our test, always-HD froze for nearly twelve seconds. Adaptive never froze.
So a blurry moment means the app chose to keep playing.
